Hi John — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned. I’ve attached a lightweight runsheet and a draft SOW for budgeting/PO next steps.

Key success criteria (from discovery):
- Avg inference latency for 95th pctile < 120ms for the 1k token baseline test
- Query throughput: sustain 200 qps in burst window (15m) with < 10% degradation
- Relevance metric: top-3 accuracy >= 86% on your labeled eval set (sample provided)
- Data handling: logs masked and retained per your policy (30 days) and data stays in US region

Proposed evaluation plan & owner matrix:
- Kickoff & environment prep (owner: Logan) — week of Mar 22
- Integration & seed dataset ingestion (owner: Priya) — week 1
- Baseline performance tests + tuning (owner: Priya) — week 2
- Feature validation & user-simulated workloads (owner: Marissa) — week 3
- Final readout, results, and next-step recommendations (owner: Logan) — week 4

Cadence: weekly check-ins, Wednesdays 10:00 AM PT (30m). We’ll capture action items in the runsheet and aim for a concise final readout deck.

Attachments: POC_Runsheet_v1.xlsx (detailed milestones + gating criteria), POC_SOW_Draft_OliveTech_2027.pdf, Weekly_Checkin_Agenda.docx

Asks for you before kickoff:
1) Confirm success criteria above or add anything missing
2) Provide sandbox credentials or a test endpoint (cert/key) with a contact for network whitelisting
3) Approve kickoff week (we proposed week of Mar 22)

If that all looks good I’ll send calendar invites and a DocuSign SOW link for signature.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Logan Wright

Logan— appreciate the clear plan and the runsheet. A few quick notes from our side after internal review: 
- The success criteria look right but we need one additional metric: end-to-end PII scrub rate for outputs > 99.9% (we’ll share a small test pack)
- For throughput, we can start at 150 qps and scale to 200 qps by week 2 if tuning goes well
- Our security team requires that logs remain in a US-only region and that access is via our SSO (OIDC) for the service account

Regarding dates: week of Mar 22 works but our integration lead is on site Mar 23–24. Can we kickoff the onboarding call Mar 24 at 10 AM PT instead? That gives us time to line up the network team and credentials.

We’ll upload the sample eval set to the shared Drive link you provided by EOD tomorrow. Also looping Sara (platform lead) for the SSO and network details.

Thanks — John
